CSV Engine

A fast, zero-dependency tabular data engine. Automatic delimiter detection, relational joins, grouping, pivot tables, column/row reordering, schema validation, and tabular diffing.

RFC 4180 Specification
34 Engine Operations
Auto Delimiter Sniffing
SQL-like Join & Group By

Relational Tabular Capabilities

Auto Delimiter Sniffing

Instantly detect commas, tabs, semicolons, and pipes while safely parsing multiline escaped quotes.

CsvEngine.detectDelimiter(text)

Relational Joins & Grouping

Perform inner, left, and full joins between CSV datasets, compute aggregations, and generate pivot tables.

CsvEngine.join(csvA, csvB, 'id')

Column & Row Reordering

Reorder column sequences, drop sensitive columns, rename headers, and sort rows by multi-column comparators.

CsvEngine.reorderColumns(csv, ['id', 'name'])

Data Profiling & Schema

Profile column null counts, infer column data types (dates, integers, booleans), and validate strict schemas.

CsvEngine.profile(csvText)

Interactive Code Example

import { CsvEngine } from '/assets/js/index.js';

const rawCsv = `id,country,sales,year\n1,USA,50000,2025\n2,Germany,34000,2025\n3,USA,62000,2026`;

// 1. Reorder columns & filter rows
const filtered = CsvEngine.filter(rawCsv, row => Number(row.sales) > 40000);
const reordered = CsvEngine.reorderColumns(filtered, ['country', 'sales', 'year']);

// 2. Group by country with aggregation
const summary = CsvEngine.groupBy(rawCsv, 'country', {
  totalSales: rows => rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + Number(r.sales), 0)
});

// 3. Convert to Excel or JSON
const json = CsvEngine.toJson(reordered);
console.log('Summary JSON:', json);
